claims.statement: For every genuine Boolean f and Bernoulli-t live set J, the expected upward potential of the uniform physical restrictions f_{J,X} is at most F_t(p)=E_J sum_{A subset J} m_J(A) log_2(pi(A)/m_J(A)), where p(T)=fhat(T)^2, m_J(A)=P_{S~p}[S intersect J=A], and pi(A)=P[S contains A]. F_t has an exact nonnegative coordinate decomposition sum_i C_i(t). Hence some i with p_i=Inf_i(f)>0 has C_i(t)/p_i >= F_t/I. For a finite-dimensional H/I maximizer of ratio R, the accepted A052 persistence theorem implies at t=1/2 that this ratio is at least (R-2)/4-1/(2 ln 2), plus the retained normalized terminal variance and empty-coefficient entropy terms.
claims.quantifiers: Every n>=1; every genuine {-1,1}-valued Boolean function on the uniform n-cube; every t in [0,1]; every fixed global coordinate order. The critical consequence applies to fixed-n H/I maximizers and genuine physical restrictions.
claims.units: bits for entropy and surprisal; dimensionless normalized charges
hypotheses: Uniform Boolean cube and genuine Boolean f
Physical restriction assignments are uniform on the fixed coordinates
The maximizer consequence imports the source-complete A052 random-restriction persistence theorem
The p_i<1/2 addendum for R>4 imports the prior all-block critical theorem
scope_exclusions: Not a proof of full FEI
No universal upper bound max_i C_i(t)/p_i<=K is proved
No claim that an arbitrary spectral probability law is Boolean-realizable or critical
Finite enumeration is diagnostic and not the all-dimensional proof
